import ctypes
import os


def assert_test():
    # Load the libraries in the correct order
    libgslcblas_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so"
    libgsl_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so"

    assert os.path.exists(libgslcblas_path), "libgslcblas.so not found at the specified path."
    assert os.path.exists(libgsl_path), "libgsl.so not found at the specified path."

    ctypes.CDLL(libgslcblas_path, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL(libgsl_path)

    # Define the GSL vector structure
    class GSLVector(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [
            ("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
            ("stride", ctypes.c_size_t),
            ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
            ("block", ctypes.c_void_p),
            ("owner", ctypes.c_int)
        ]

    # Define the C function prototypes
    gsl_vector_alloc = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc
    gsl_vector_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector)

    gsl_vector_set = gsl.gsl_vector_set
    gsl_vector_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]
    gsl_vector_set.restype = None

    gsl_vector_get = gsl.gsl_vector_get
    gsl_vector_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector), ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl_vector_get.restype = ctypes.c_double

    gsl_vector_free = gsl.gsl_vector_free
    gsl_vector_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector)]
    gsl_vector_free.restype = None

    # Allocate a GSL vector
    size = 3
    vector = gsl_vector_alloc(size)
    assert vector, "Failed to allocate GSL vector."

    # Set values in the vector
    gsl_vector_set(vector, 0, 1.1)
    gsl_vector_set(vector, 1, 2.2)
    gsl_vector_set(vector, 2, 3.3)

    # Retrieve a value from the vector
    value = gsl_vector_get(vector, 1)
    assert abs(value - 2.2) < 1e-6, f"Unexpected value retrieved: {value}"

    print(f"Retrieved value: {value}")

    # Free the vector
    gsl_vector_free(vector)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
